hiw.title: How platform plans work
hiw.subtitle: Simple steps for you to decide

choosePlan.title: Choose a plan
choosePlan.desc: Pick a plan that fits your shop — small, medium or large.

knowFee.title: Know the fee
knowFee.desc: Each plan shows the small percentage or fixed fee you will pay.

payWhenAgree.title: Pay when you agree
payWhenAgree.desc: You pay the platform fee only after you accept the plan.

quickExample.title: Quick example
quickExample.example1: If you sell for ₹1000 and fee is 1% (percentage plan), platform takes ₹10.
quickExample.example2: If the plan is fixed value and fee is ₹20 per order, platform takes ₹20.

moreThings.title: A few more things to know
moreThings.item1: Fee is taken on each order you accept through the platform.
moreThings.item2: Some plans may include tax — the plan details will show if GST is included or added on top.
moreThings.item3: You will only start paying after you subscribe to a plan and accept its terms.
